a.xlink:title: Frontend state ownership. Combines service worker, TanStack Query, Dexie safe snapshots, Zustand UI-only state, XState guided flows, API client, error boundaries, and generated fixtures without owning backend truth.
React / Vite PWA. Renders Lite screens and sends same-origin requests only to FastAPI through Caddy.
App Catalog. Presents backend-owned app lifecycle and safe action readiness, including same-origin Open routes and Manage details.
Caddy same-origin proxy. Serves the PWA and routes /api/lite/* and managed app paths without exposing backend secrets.
